description: This file contains unit tests for the ModuleDao class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing functionalities related to modules such as retrieving module list, updating module statuses, and fetching disabled modules.

classes.name: ModuleDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ModuleDao, testing module list retrieval, status updates, and disabled module listings.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the ModuleDao instance and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of modules, ensuring correct count and module properties.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Tests updating module status and verifies that the changes are reflected correctly.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusForReturnedValues
methods.description: Ensures that updateModuleStatus returns the correct number of Module objects with updated statuses.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusWithModulesDoesNotExists
methods.description: Checks behavior when attempting to update statuses for modules that do not exist; ensures the method does not incorrectly include nonexistent modules.

methods.name: testDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of disabled modules, verifying that only modules with 'maintenance' status are returned.
